name: cniska-gates
description: Saves agents the round trip through agent-gates' gates: at session start it tells the agent which gates the checkout installs, read from their markers, and how each refuses; after each edit it runs the format gate's command and tells the agent which comments the edit added and why they are refused, before it commits; and it denies a git command that would skip the gates, such as --no-verify or a core.hooksPath override, naming the gates to fix instead. It never blocks an edit, and changes no file but what the format command writes.
